content:
At the moment, docs#Submodule.orthogonalProjection goes through an implementation definition docs#Submodule.orthogonalProjectionFn.
But, now that we have docs#Submodule.IsTopCompl and docs#Submodule.projectionOntoL, we can directly prove IsTopCompl K Kᗮ in a much shorter and neater way, and then directly define orthogonalProjection as projectionOntoL (maybe as an abbrev?). This also removes all the need for public lemmas that are unusable outside the file (everything about orthogonalProjectionFn).

I wanted to see what others thought before I go ahead with the refactor.

I noticed this when I was renaming Submodule.orthogonalProjection to Submodule.orthogonalProjectionOnto yesterday in #38970.
